messages:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty triggered: HIGH for service `inference-gateway` (eu-west1). Alert: `egress_5xx_rate > 10%` — auto-page to `oncall-sre`. https://pd.example/INC123456 :warning:
incident-bot: Created incident channel #incident-4419876543. Runbook: https://playbooks/internal/inference/5xx-spike
maya: ack'ing. seeing a huge 502 spike from eu-west1 -> customers getting >10% errors. Can reproduce with curl from eu-west1 jump host.
jonathan: copying logs now. quick check — are we seeing kvcache evictions or proxy errors?
maya: logs show repeated `upstream response code 502` from model-backend-0..3. kvcache_evictions spiked at 10:22 UTC. snippet:```
[22:23:11] inference-gateway: upstream resp=502 id=abc123 model=v2.3.1 seq=512
[22:23:12] kvcache: evict key=prefix:usr:987 size=84KB reason=mem_pressure
```
zara: if it's kvcache thrashing, prefix caching fallback may help. can we route traffic to a warmed variant (v2.3.0) while we triage?
leo: trying to disable canary routing that started at 22:15. looks like the canary pool is small and saturating heads. initiating rollback of model-route to stable.
jonathan: while that's rolling, can we mute PD noisy alerts? they're firing every minute due to duplicates. i'll suppress the alert rule for eu-west1 for 10m.
oncall-sre: @maya — are you on the bridge? i'll take the followups after rollback.
maya: on the bridge. rolling to v2.3.0 now:```
# roll traffic back to stable
rolloutctl traffic set inference-service --model v2.3.0 --region eu-west1 --weight 100
```
incident-bot: Action logged: traffic rollback requested by maya. See deployment event: https://ci.internal/deploy/9876
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty note: alert suppressed for 10 minutes by jonathan.
leo: also restarting the edge proxy on the two eu-west1 frontends — one had a long-lived connection backlog. running:```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/ingress-proxy-eu-west1
```
maya: rollback completed at ~22:31 UTC. initial error rate dropped from 11.4% -> 0.9% within 3 minutes. still monitoring for flapping.
jonathan: autoscaler metrics show reserved pool saturated during the spike. creating temporary burst-capacity (allow-burst=true) for 15m: `infractl pool adjust --name eu-dedicated --burst 6`
zara: confirming customer impact: support queue shows ~18 unique requests reporting 502s between 22:20-22:33. no major tenant outage called yet. labeling impact: degraded for some customers, partial.
oncall-sre: good mitigation steps taken. i'll keep the channel open and hand this to morning oncall for postmortem. please add to the incident ticket: suspected root cause = canary routing to v2.3.1 + kvcache eviction under memory pressure => cascade of 502s.
maya: agree. created PD incident note and assigned follow-ups: investigate kvcache memory thresholds, add circuit-breaker for unstable model variants, improve alert dedupe.
jonathan: will create a short postmortem PR with timeline. tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre.
leo: closing actions: rollback confirmed, proxies restarted, burst capacity added, PD suppression lifted at 22:42.
maya: marking incident RESOLVED in PD and closing channel in 10m if no further alerts. thanks all :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident channel will auto-close in 10 minutes if no activity.
